```{r}
# Assuming 'world' is your dataset with a column 'region' or 'country' containing country names
madagascar <- world[world$region == "Madagascar", ] # Filter for Madagascar

#give other sample a different shape
kml_data$Name <- c("Merina","Sakalava","Betsimisaraka","Betsileo","Diego", "Temoro","Vezo","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea")

ours <- rep(0,5)
pierron <- rep(1,9)
sample <- c(ours,pierron)
kml_data$sample <- sample

# Plotting only Madagascar
madagascar_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = madagascar, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), fill = "grey") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-30, -10)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-45, -5))+
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data, coords = c("lon", "lat")), aes(shape = factor(sample)), color = "darkblue", size = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17),labels = c("Our sample", "From literature")) +
   labs(shape = NULL) +
   coord_sf(xlim = c(30, 60), ylim = c(-45, -5))
madagascar_plot
```

# New plan for map with rnaturalearth

```{r}
#WGS84 is standard, but lets use Laborde 
Madagascar <- ne_countries(country = "Madagascar", type = "map_units", scale = "medium")

ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = Madagascar)+
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702)) + # Laborde projection, commonly used for Madagascar
  theme_light()

```


```{r}

  geom_sf(data = Madagascar_inset)+
```

```{r}
# Dissolve boundaries into a single geometry
Madagascar_dissolved <- Madagascar_inset %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf()  # Convert back to sf object

# Plot the map without boundaries
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = Madagascar_dissolved) + 
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702)) # Laborde projection
```

```{r}
kml_data <- sf::st_read(dsn = resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/raw/data_input/Data_with_pierron.kml"))
kml_data <- sf::st_transform(kml_data, crs = 29702)

#Add names
kml_data$Name <- c("Merina","Sakalava","Betsimisaraka","Betsileo","Diego", "Temoro","Vezo","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea")

kml_data <- kml_data %>%
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1], 
         y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2])


ours <- rep(0,5)
pierron <- rep(1,9)
sample <- c(ours,pierron)
kml_data$sample <- sample


labels_data <- kml_data %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y),
    geometry = st_centroid(st_union(geometry))  # Optional: Keeps geometry if needed
  )


ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = Madagascar_dissolved)+
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data),aes(shape = factor(sample)), size = 1)+
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702), xlim = c(-1000000,1800000), ylim = c(1,2000000),expand = FALSE) + # Laborde projection, commonly used for Madagascar
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17),labels = c("Our sample", "From literature")) +
   labs(shape = NULL) +
  #geom_text(data = kml_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Name), size = 3, hjust = -0.3)
  geom_text(data = labels_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Name), size = 3, hjust = -0.3)+
  #geom_text_repel(data = labels_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = Name), max.overlaps = 10, force = 200)+
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)


ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_map_labels.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

# Data currently merged in: Malagasy, 1000 Genomes, Borneo, Sumba

```{r}
# Get all African countries
africa_eurasia <- ne_countries(continent = c("Africa", "Asia"), scale = 50, returnclass = "sf") #%>% st_union() %>% st_as_sf()

# Specify countries to highlight and assign colors
highlighted_countries <- africa_eurasia %>%
  mutate(fill_color = case_when(
    name %in% c("Madagascar", "Kenya", "Nigeria", "Sierra Leone", "The Gambia", "China", "Vietnam", "Pakistan", "Bangladesh", "Indonesia") ~ "highlight", # Countries to color
    TRUE ~ "base" # Default color for other countries
  ))


# Plot current data 
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = highlighted_countries, aes(fill = fill_color)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("highlight" = "#FFDBBB", "base" = "gray80")) +
  #coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702), xlim = c(-1500000,4800000), ylim = c(-1500000,4500000)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA))

```


```{r}
# Get all African countries
africa_eurasia <- ne_countries(continent = c("Africa", "Asia"), scale = 50, returnclass = "sf") #%>% st_union() %>% st_as_sf()

# Define the two lists of countries
highlight_list1 <- c("Madagascar", "Kenya", "Nigeria", "Sierra Leone", "The Gambia", "China", "Vietnam", "Pakistan", "Bangladesh", "Indonesia")
highlight_list2 <- c("Zambia","Ethiopia", "Kenya", "Nigeria", "South Africa", "Ghana", "Senegal", "Mozambique", "Angola")
highlight_list3 <- c("Malaysia","Philippines")

# Brenton et al 2024 - "Zambia"
# Gurdansi et al 2015 - "Ethiopia", "Kenya, "Nigeria", "South Africa", "Ghana", "Senegal"
# Semo et al 2020 - "Mozambique","Angola"

# Morseburg et al 2016 - "Malaysia","Philippines"


# Add color categories to the dataset
highlighted_countries <- africa_eurasia %>%
  mutate(fill_color = case_when(
    name %in% highlight_list1 ~ "Current_data", # First list of countries
    name %in% highlight_list2 ~ "Potential_African_data", # Second list of countries
    name %in% highlight_list3 ~ "Potential_Asian_data", # Third list of countries
    TRUE ~ "base" # Default color for other countries
  ))

# Plot with multiple highlight colors
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = highlighted_countries, aes(fill = fill_color)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Current_data" = "#FFDBBB",
    "Potential_African_data" = "#B3E2CD",
    "Potential_Asian_data" = "#FDFD96",
    "base" = "gray80"         # Default color
  )) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  labs(fill = "Highlight Groups")




```
